question: Given the last error and the paths already tried, what should happen next?

options.retry_same: run the identical call again unchanged
options.change_input: run the same tool with different arguments
options.reroute: use a different tool or approach for the same goal
options.fallback_model: hand the turn to a stronger or different model
options.ask_user: stop and ask the user a clarifying question
options.stop: give up and report the failure honestly
